en.name: Jiubao
en.ability: One of your good neighbors (not Travellers) is drunk, even if you die by execution.

revisions.v1: One of your townsfolk neighbour is drunk, even if you are dead.
revisions.v2026-07: One of your good neighbors (not Travellers) is drunk, even if you die by execution.

zh.name: 酒保
zh.ability: 与你邻近的善良玩家（旅行者除外）之一醉酒，即使你死于处决。

revisions.v1: 与你邻近的善良玩家之一醉酒，即使你已死亡。
